content: Two Ollama community providers listed on ai-sdk.dev: ai-sdk-ollama 4.3.0 (jagreehal; built on official ollama-js; peer ai ^7.0.95; tool-calling reliability, jsonrepair, exposes num_ctx/mirostat options; 4.x=ai7, 3.x=ai6) and ollama-ai-provider-v2 4.0.1 (nordwestt; direct HTTP; peer ai ^7). Alternative: openai-compatible against http://localhost:11434/v1 but no num_ctx control.
